notes.title: Realise Patch 1.0.0
notes.content:
- Correction of gameplay
- Correction of weapons (synchronization of weapons)
- Correction of the physics of the details (shaking and flying of the car due to installed additional parts)
- Correction of auto control (correction of control from the center of gravity)
- Added the game mode settings menu

notes.title: Work on PATH 1.01
notes.content:
Dear players, opened a topic on the forum Steam, write there about the problems with which you have come across.
From what we already knew:
1. Crash game for no apparent reason.
2. Synchronization of weapons
3. Compensation of lags
4. Problems with physics

notes.title: Release 1.0
notes.content:
Hello, friends. Today we released the game of the first version. We apologize in advance for possible problems with the game, there may be more of them, and maybe less. If you find a problem, bug, crash or anything else, let us know by mail. 
raumincorporated@gmail.com

notes.title: New Year's Ready!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31227847/d878f2e43647fa5bb7eea68d0f5159e4ad7d499b.jpg[/img]
Friends, 
On the eve of Christmas (and for the release of the Wheel Riders Online, for sure) we've prepared for you a holiday atmosphere in the game!
You'll be able to see special X-mas decorations in your garage. Besides we gonna adding some new spares for creating such cool cars as the legendary DeLorean!

Thank you for being with us!
